title: TIGHC game profile
description: Structural contract for a <profile-id>/profile.json file, derived from how TIGHC/Engine's src/profiles.py (_load_profile, _parse_devices_field) and src/ranges.py (VibeRange) actually parse and validate a profile at load time. A profile that fails this schema would raise ValueError/RuntimeError in the Engine, or (for the bindings/priority rules noted below) is a repo-convention requirement stricter than the Engine's own defaults. See Engine tests/test_profiles.py and tests/test_ranges.py for the reference behavior this schema mirrors.

name.description: Display name shown in the GUI. Optional in the Engine - falls back to the profile's folder name when omitted (_load_profile: data.get('name', profile_dir.name)) - but every profile in this repo sets it explicitly.

window_titles.description: Substrings (or, with window_title_exact, full strings) matched case-sensitively against the foreground window title. Engine requires at least one entry (_load_profile raises ValueError('profile.json needs at least one entry in window_titles') otherwise).

window_title_exact.description: When true, window_titles entries must equal the full window title exactly instead of matching as a substring. Defaults to false.

priority.description: Binding ids in highest-to-lowest priority order, used by the GUI. Purely advisory to the Engine (not validated there), but this repo's test suite additionally checks every entry names a real binding id in this same profile.

steamgriddb_id.description: Optional SteamGridDB game id, pinning cover-art lookup to an exact game instead of searching by name.

steamgriddb_grid_id.description: Optional SteamGridDB grid (cover image) id, pinning artwork to one exact image instead of the default top-voted one.

bindings.description: The profile's keybindings. The Engine itself tolerates an empty/omitted list (data.get('bindings', [])), but a profile in this repo is expected to actually do something, so this schema requires at least one entry.

background.description: Optional idle vibe band used when no binding is active. Not currently read by the Engine's profile loader, but documented in this repo's README as part of the profile format; kept optional and permissive here for forward compatibility.

vibeRange.description: A [low, high] 0.0-1.0 intensity band (src/ranges.py VibeRange). Engine additionally requires low <= high (VibeRange.__post_init__), which this repo's test suite checks separately since plain JSON Schema can't compare two array elements to each other.

id.description: Unique identifier for this binding within the profile. Engine raises ValueError('duplicate binding id ...') on repeats (checked separately - JSON Schema can't express uniqueness keyed on one object property across array items).

keys.description: Key/button tokens that trigger this binding (lowercased by the Engine). Must be non-empty - Engine raises ValueError("binding '...' has no keys") otherwise.

enabled.description: Whether this binding is active for event dispatch. Defaults to true. Disabled bindings are still recorded for the startup banner/GUI but excluded from bindings_by_key.

devices.description: Channel nicknames this binding targets, or ["all"] (case-insensitive) for every channel. Optional - defaults to ["all"] when omitted. If present, must be a non-empty list (Engine's _parse_devices_field raises ValueError otherwise).

mode.description: Documented in this repo's README ("continuous" vs "pulse") but not currently read by the Engine's profile loader (_load_profile hardcodes mode=None regardless of this field). Kept optional/permissive for forward compatibility.
